cohort: The study participants were women with triplet pregnancies.
finding: Short cervical length and the degree of cervical change by 28 weeks did not predict unscheduled preterm birth in triplet pregnancies, although triplets conceived by ARTs may have an increased risk of unscheduled preterm birth.
gest_age: Median gestational age at delivery was 32.7 (IQR 2.3) weeks, with outcomes measured for births <30 and <34 weeks.
